// Grade 6 CAPS-aligned questions for South Africa
// Each question: { q, opts, ans (index of correct option) }

export const questions = {
  numbers: [
    { q: 'What is the value of the digit 7 in the number 3 742 581?', opts: ['700 000', '70 000', '7 000 000', '7 000'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Round 4 836 295 to the nearest 100 000.', opts: ['4 800 000', '4 900 000', '4 836 000', '5 000 000'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Which number is 100 more than 2 999 900?', opts: ['3 000 000', '2 999 000', '3 000 900', '2 999 990'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the LCM of 4 and 6?', opts: ['12', '24', '6', '8'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the HCF of 18 and 24?', opts: ['6', '3', '12', '9'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Which is a prime number?', opts: ['37', '51', '49', '77'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is 3⁴ (3 to the power of 4)?', opts: ['81', '64', '27', '12'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A school has 12 600 learners. 4 200 are in Grade 6. What fraction is Grade 6?', opts: ['1/3', '1/4', '2/5', '1/2'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the square root of 144?', opts: ['12', '14', '11', '13'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Write 3 204 781 in words.', opts: ['Three million two hundred and four thousand seven hundred and eighty-one', 'Three hundred and two million four thousand seven hundred and eighty-one', 'Thirty-two million four hundred and seven hundred and eighty-one', 'Three billion two hundred and four thousand'], ans: 0 },
  ],
  fractions: [
    { q: 'What is ¾ + ⅝?', opts: ['11/8 (1⅜)', '8/12', '5/12', '1½'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is ⅔ × ¾?', opts: ['½', '6/12', '8/12', '3/8'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Write 0.45 as a fraction in simplest form.', opts: ['9/20', '45/10', '4/5', '9/10'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is 15% of 200?', opts: ['30', '25', '35', '15'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Which fraction is greater: 5/8 or 3/5?', opts: ['5/8', '3/5', 'They are equal', 'Cannot tell'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'If ⅓ of a number is 24, what is the number?', opts: ['72', '8', '48', '36'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is 2½ - ¾?', opts: ['1¾', '1½', '2¼', '1¼'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A pizza is cut into 8 slices. Thabo ate 3 slices. What fraction is left?', opts: ['5/8', '3/8', '4/8', '2/8'], ans: 0 },
  ],
  geometry: [
    { q: 'How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?', opts: ['6', '3', '4', '8'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What type of angle is 125°?', opts: ['Obtuse', 'Acute', 'Right', 'Reflex'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A quadrilateral with one pair of parallel sides is called a…', opts: ['Trapezium', 'Parallelogram', 'Rhombus', 'Rectangle'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the sum of interior angles of a triangle?', opts: ['180°', '360°', '90°', '270°'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A triangular prism has how many faces?', opts: ['5', '6', '4', '7'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the name of a polygon with 8 sides?', opts: ['Octagon', 'Hexagon', 'Heptagon', 'Decagon'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is 360° ÷ 6? (Interior angle of a regular hexagon)', opts: ['60°', '72°', '90°', '45°'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A cube has how many edges?', opts: ['12', '8', '6', '16'], ans: 0 },
  ],
  measure: [
    { q: 'How many millilitres are in 3.5 litres?', opts: ['3 500 mℓ', '350 mℓ', '35 000 mℓ', '3 050 mℓ'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A race is 5 km. Convert to metres.', opts: ['5 000 m', '500 m', '50 000 m', '5 00 m'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A bag of oranges weighs 2.75 kg. What is that in grams?', opts: ['2 750 g', '275 g', '27 500 g', '2 075 g'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'It is 09:45. What time will it be in 2 hours 30 minutes?', opts: ['12:15', '11:45', '12:45', '11:15'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is the temperature difference between 38°C and -4°C?', opts: ['42°C', '34°C', '42°F', '36°C'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its perimeter?', opts: ['26 cm', '40 cm', '13 cm', '20 cm'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'How many centimetres in 3.2 metres?', opts: ['320 cm', '32 cm', '3 200 cm', '3.2 cm'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A film starts at 14:25 and lasts 1 hour 45 minutes. When does it end?', opts: ['16:10', '15:70', '15:10', '16:25'], ans: 0 },
  ],
  data: [
    { q: 'Data set: 3, 7, 2, 7, 5, 8, 7. What is the mode?', opts: ['7', '5', '3', '8'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Data set: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. What is the median?', opts: ['8', '6', '10', '7'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Data set: 10, 20, 30, 40. What is the mean?', opts: ['25', '20', '30', '100'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Data set: 5, 12, 3, 19, 7. What is the range?', opts: ['16', '14', '19', '12'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A pie chart shows 25% for soccer. If 200 learners were surveyed, how many prefer soccer?', opts: ['50', '25', '75', '100'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Which type of graph is best for showing change over time?', opts: ['Line graph', 'Bar graph', 'Pie chart', 'Pictograph'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Data: 14, 9, 22, 14, 7. What is the mean? (Round to nearest whole number)', opts: ['13', '14', '11', '15'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Which average is most affected by a very large outlier?', opts: ['Mean', 'Median', 'Mode', 'Range'], ans: 0 },
  ],
};

export const factorSets = {
  12: [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12],
  18: [1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18],
  24: [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24],
  30: [1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30],
  36: [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36],
};

export const pctProblems = [
  { q: 'What is 20% of 350?', ans: 70, unit: '' },
  { q: 'Write 3/4 as a percentage.', ans: 75, unit: '%' },
  { q: 'A shirt costs R240 with a 15% discount. What is the discount amount?', ans: 36, unit: 'R' },
  { q: 'What is 35% of 600?', ans: 210, unit: '' },
  { q: 'Write 0.6 as a percentage.', ans: 60, unit: '%' },
  { q: 'A soccer team won 18 of 24 games. What percentage did they win?', ans: 75, unit: '%' },
  { q: 'What is 5% of 1 200?', ans: 60, unit: 'R' },
  { q: 'A book costs R80. VAT is 15%. What is the VAT amount?', ans: 12, unit: 'R' },
];

export const areaProblems = [
  { type: 'Rectangle', l: 8, w: 5, unit: 'cm' },
  { type: 'Rectangle', l: 12, w: 7, unit: 'm' },
  { type: 'Rectangle', l: 15, w: 9, unit: 'cm' },
  { type: 'Square', l: 6, w: 6, unit: 'm' },
  { type: 'Square', l: 11, w: 11, unit: 'cm' },
  { type: 'Rectangle', l: 20, w: 4, unit: 'm' },
];
